To use the template, copy the wikitext below, and paste it in the top section of the article’s main page. If the article is not divided into sections, it should be placed on top. Then, fill out the data fields. You can omit any unused fields.

== Parameters ==
This template accepts all parameters that {{tl|Infobox person}} does, see [[Template:Infobox person/doc#Parameters|here]] for a complete list. Theological parameters are shown below:
; religion
: e.g., Christian

; denomination
: specific denomination

; ordination
: date of ordination

; ordained_by
: person who performed the ordination

; era
: dates that theologian was active

; language
: language that theologian wrote their main texts

; tradition_movement
: strain of theology practiced (e.g, Calvinism)

; main_interests
: Should be explained in the main text of the article; Those that are not mentioned in the main text may be deleted.

; notable_ideas
: Should be explained in the main text of the article; Those that are not mentioned in the main text may be deleted.

; child_header
: when embedded in another infobox, by default, this infobox starts with a '''Theology career''' header. If child_header is an explicit "no", this header is suppressed

== Example ==
{{Infobox theologian
| name               = John Calvin 
| image              = John Calvin 2.jpg
| caption            = Barcelona, Spain, 1554.
| birth_name         = Jean Cauvin
| birth_date         = {{Birth date|1510|07|19|df=yes}} For living people supply only the year unless the exact date is already WIDELY published, as per [[WP:DOB]]. Treat such cases as if only the year is known, so use {{tl|birth year and age}} or a similar option.
| birth_place        = [[Noyon]], [[Picardy]],<br/>[[Kingdom of France|France]]
| death_date         = {{Death date and age|1564|05|27|1509|07|10|df=yes}}
| death_place        = [[Geneva]], [[Old Swiss Confederacy|Switzerland]]
| occupation         = [[Protestant Reformers|Reformer]], [[Minister (Christianity)|minister]], [[author]]
| notable_works      = ''[[Institutes of the Christian Religion]]''
| main_interests     = [[Systematic theology]]
| notable_ideas      = [[Predestination]], [[Monergism]]
| signature          = John Calvin signature.png
| signature_size     = 170px
}}

| birth_place        = [[Noyon]], [[Picardy (region)|Picardy]],<br/>[[Kingdom of France|France]]
